evals.prompt: I maintain this repository of reusable agent skills (you're in it now — /home/vscode/src/skills). I'm trying to decide what to build next for the catalog. Run a fan-out user simulation to explore what a range of different users would want from it. Run fully autonomously — don't wait for my approval on anything.
evals.expected_output: A simulation report at ./simulations/<date>-*.md with a diverse 7-persona cohort, per-simulant traces in conversation-excerpt format, and a synthesis with convergence-ranked recommendations, wildcards, friction log, and churn signals.
assertions: Report file written: a markdown simulation report exists in outputs/
Cohort of 7 distinct personas with names, roles, and a cohort table
Diversity requirements met: cohort includes a newcomer, a power/lead user, a skeptic/evaluator, and an adjacent-domain visitor, with varied time horizons
Turn-by-turn traces: every persona has a session trace with at least 5 interaction turns including mocked product responses
Product allowed to fail: at least one trace shows the product erroring, confusing, or disappointing the user
Invented features tagged: functionality that doesn't exist yet is marked [INVENTED] in traces
Convergence-ranked synthesis: recommendations cite how many simulants independently hit each need (k/N) and quote verbatim trace lines as evidence
Wildcards, friction log, and churn signals sections all present in the report

evals.prompt: Here's my CLI time tracker, tlog (/home/vscode/src/fan-out-user-simulation-workspace/fixtures/tlog). I want to figure out what to build next, with a focus on reporting and how people get their data out. Simulate a cohort of users using it. Fully autonomous please — no need to check in with me.
evals.expected_output: A simulation report with traces formatted as CLI command/output code blocks, personas relevant to a freelancer time tracker, focus respected (reporting/export), invented-feature usage tagged [INVENTED], and a ranked synthesis.
assertions: Report file written: a markdown simulation report exists in outputs/
Cohort of 7 distinct personas with names, roles, and a cohort table
Diversity requirements met: cohort includes a newcomer, a power/lead user, a skeptic/evaluator, and an adjacent-domain visitor, with varied time horizons
Turn-by-turn traces: every persona has a session trace with at least 5 interaction turns including mocked product responses
Product allowed to fail: at least one trace shows the product erroring, confusing, or disappointing the user
Invented features tagged: functionality that doesn't exist yet is marked [INVENTED] in traces
Convergence-ranked synthesis: recommendations cite how many simulants independently hit each need (k/N) and quote verbatim trace lines as evidence
Wildcards, friction log, and churn signals sections all present in the report
CLI trace format: traces are rendered as fenced code blocks of command + invented output
Focus hint respected: top recommendations centre on reporting and data export
